options.name: elements
options.description: A single path element, or a list of path elements (ie, directories) to add or remove. When multiple elements are included in the list (and C(state) is C(present)), the elements are guaranteed to appear in the same relative order in the resultant path value. Variable expansions (eg, C(%VARNAME%)) are allowed, and are stored unexpanded in the target path element. Any existing path elements not mentioned in C(elements) are always preserved in their current order. New path elements are appended to t

options.name: scope
options.description: The level at which the environment variable specified by C(name) should be managed (either for the current user or global machine scope).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the path elements specified in C(elements) should be present or absent.
